name: Land & General Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司业务板块未在公告中披露具体的扩张、新增、缩减或出售动作；公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会及股息相关事项。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长61.5%，净利润同比增长88.7%。
overview_en: In 2026, no specific expansion, new business, reduction, or divestment actions were disclosed in the announcements for the business segments; announcements mainly covered quarterly results, general meetings, and dividend matters. The latest quarter (2026-06-30) saw revenue increase by 61.5% year-on-year and net profit increase by 88.7% year-on-year.
